analysis.summary: Management reported a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19, or 13% adjusted for billing methodology changes in domestic sales, while international revenues crossed the $20 million milestone. Gross and EBITDA margins expanded during the period supported by volume growth, benign raw material prices, and tight control on operating expenses. For the outlook, the company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capex during the year and plans to increase prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices. Management also noted that no major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement as existing capacity gets utilized more efficiently.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capex during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects another good year in FY20 as the Vadilal brand is leveraged for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better consumption environment, demand shift to the organized sector, and international business traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to expand past the $ 20 million milestone driven by strong demand from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Strong growth in demand in international markets prompts a deeper penetration strategy to address product availability gaps.
demand_outlook.quote: Based on the strong growth in demand, we are looking to penetrate deeper into these markets to address the gap in the availability of Indian products to the community.

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY 20 is around Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: Distribution investments have been committed in multiple locations in the U.S.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY 19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year with contributions from U.S. operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Visibility of stable costs is covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Prices will be looked to be increased in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

margins_costs.claim: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates production facilities including Bareilly (150,000 liters per day), Dharampur (33,000 kgs per day), and Pundhra (230,000 liters per day).
orders_capacity.quote:
Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005
Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6
Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash accretion from the business and working capital improvements allow the company to continue debt rationalization as planned.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: o Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capex during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to expanding its distribution network judiciously.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.
